Hi Nusrat, thank you for your honest feedback and we're really sorry about the wait. A 40 minute delay with no explanation isn't how we want to treat our guests, and that's on us. We're glad the food hit the mark at least. Please give us a call on +44 20 7946 0123 so we can make it right for you next time. 🙏

The Ember & Spice Grill family
